guardrails: V14 is evidence-only and must not modify worker routing or execution claims.
The chosen routing must be independently re-solved from routing_candidates.jsonl.
Pair criticality is the global score loss when the chosen pair is forbidden and the full matching is re-optimized.
Local next-best scores are descriptive and may exceed the chosen local edge because the chosen route optimizes the global matching.
No causal regret claim is allowed; V14 preserves feasible alternatives for later matched experiments.
